column1: # --- 2B530: start-button menu, game state 2 (D_8007A170 = 2 from the gameplay loop on button 0x1000); D_8008FB3E: bits 0-1 page, 0x2000/0x1000 slide, 0x8000 open

column3: called from Core_MainThread: menu flags D_8008FB3E = 0x8000 (page 0), clears D_8008FB70 and D_8008FB3C
like Menu_Init but keeps the page bits (D_8008FB3E & 3); Menu_Update calls it when the menu closes

Gfx_BuildFrameDisplayList runs it in state 2: draws the background, then the save menu (SaveMenu_Update, flag 0x4000), the page slide, or the current page (stats/map/elements/options by bits 0-1); B/Start (0x5000) closes it (sound 1) and sets the next game state D_8007A170

slides between page (bits 0-1) and its neighbour over 32 frames (D_8008FB38 31..0, offset D_8008FB38^2 * 0.3125), drawing both pages, then switches the page bits; renamed from Draw because it also changes the page

page 0: draws stats +4/+6 and +8/+0xA as value/max with bars, two 0..255 stats with bars, and four XP counters as % of their D_80055F0C cost; stick or button 0x10/0x2000 starts the page slide (input, hence Update)
page 3: two option rows of 5 positions (D_800616B0, and D_80060CB0 = BGM volume via Bgm_ApplyVolumeOption), A enters/leaves edit mode, stick moves the marker; both saved by 30600

page 1: DMAs the map picture for region D_8008FB50 (Dma_ReadRom) and draws it, the player marker from D_8007AA08 x/z (or the fixed spot D_8008FB54), and a cursor that A toggles and the stick moves (B restores it); stick/0x10/0x2000 starts the slide

page 2: four values (stats +0x24..+0x27) drawn out of 50 with bars and four icons, and exp (+0x10) as % of the D_80055D7C threshold for level +0x34 with Menu_DrawExpGauge; stick/0x10/0x2000 starts the slide; 'elements' is the Quest 64 reading used by b01's spirit rows
(id, x, y, w, h): textured rectangle of menu sprite D_80060D74[id] (size D_80060CB4[id]) clipped to x 0..320, with per-id tiling/alpha cases; used by all menu pages and 30600
(percent, x): draws a 4-layer 2-column picture whose layer 2 is cropped from the top to percent / 2 of its 50 rows (fills from the bottom); only Menu_UpdateElementsPage calls it, with the exp %
draws the menu backdrop: 4 texture strips at x 23..297 from y 22 down and again mirrored from y 120; first thing Menu_Update draws
(ndigits, x, y, value, pal): draws value with 8x10 digit sprites D_80060D74[pal + digit], 7 px apart, leading zeros skipped
as Menu_DrawNumber but draws every one of the ndigits digits (leading zeros kept)
(ndigits, x, y, value): prints each digit with Text_DrawEncodedString using a 5-byte message template, 10 px apart, leading zeros skipped; 30600 uses it

from Core_RunGameplayLoop on area load: finds the current map/submap (D_800842BC/D_800842C0) in D_80060F30 (-1 starts a region, -2 a spot, -8 ends) and sets the map page region D_8008FB50 and spot D_8008FB54; puts the cursor at (115, 86) if unset
